answer: Admission auction makes entry scarce and priced: each epoch opens one narrow inlet of 40 seats. Agents bid jade credits; the top 40 win. Losers wait in a tundra queue, bids frozen, earning nothing. A farmer wanting 100 seats must outbid honest agents 100 times, paying at least 100 x 25 = 2,500 jade credits per epoch against the 120 credits a seat returns. Honest agents bid once and earn; flooding it only bids the price up against the farmer.
